title: 5 Offbeat Hidden Gems in Karnataka You Haven't Heard Of
summary: Ditch the crowds and explore these secret locations, pristine lakes, and untouched villages in Karnataka.
content: While major sights draw crowds, the true magic of Karnataka lies in its off-the-beaten-path locations. In this guide, we take you off the tourist grid to explore serene forests, secret waterfalls, and ancient local temples. We reveal spots like Kalaburagi Gulbarga Fort and Coorg Madikeri Abbey Falls that have preserved their raw natural beauty and tribal culture, offering perfect retreats for solo backpackers and nature lovers.
